name: Leaf-fermented corn wine
summary: Vietnam Tourism opens with leaf-fermented corn wine, and also says thắng cố is often eaten with corn wine. A host may offer a shot. Vietnam Plus says Mong women are said to know how to cook corn wine, and that lợn cắp nách may be eaten with rượu ngô or rượu táo mèo. Those lines stay. Strength is Check on arrival.
howToEat: Drink it with thắng cố, when a host offers a shot, or with lợn cắp nách. Rượu táo mèo is only named beside that pork. A recipe and a strength are Check on arrival.
where: On the plateau, at the thắng cố table or when a host pours it.
